description: This file declares the NetworkManagerClient class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It provides interface declarations for managing network interfaces, Wi-Fi connections, and related functionalities, serving as a client to interact with NetworkManager over D-Bus. The file includes method signatures for operations like scanning Wi-Fi networks, connecting/disconnecting, retrieving device info, and managing configurations.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: A singleton class that provides methods to interact with network interfaces, Wi-Fi, and network configurations via D-Bus.

methods.name: NetworkManagerClient * getInstance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkManagerClient.

methods.name: getAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: setPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Sets the specified interface as primary.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for a given interface.

methods.name: getPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the current primary network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface.

methods.name: getInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if the specified interface is enabled.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Obtains IP configuration for a specified interface and IP version.

methods.name: getKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Lists SSIDs known to the device.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves info about the currently connected Wi-Fi SSID.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a Wi-Fi network to the known SSIDs list.

methods.name: removeKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Removes a Wi-Fi SSID from the known list.

methods.name: startWifiScan
methods.description: Initiates a Wi-Fi scan, optionally for a specific SSID.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if Wi-Fi scan results are recent.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device-specific info for an interface.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a Wi-Fi network using provided credentials.

methods.name: wifiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects current Wi-Fi connection.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a previously known Wi-Fi connection.

methods.name: getWifiState
methods.description: Gets current Wi-Fi operational state.

methods.name: getWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Retrieves signal quality metrics for a Wi-Fi SSID.

methods.name: startWPS
methods.description: Starts the WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) process.

methods.name: stopWPS
methods.description: Stops the ongoing WPS process.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Sets the device hostname.

methods.name: modifyDefaultConnectionsConfig
methods.description: Modifies default connection settings.

methods.name: wpsProcess
methods.description: Internal function handling WPS process logic.

methods.name: getMatchingSSIDInfo
methods.description: Helper to match SSID info during scans.

methods.name: isActiveApSameAsWps
methods.description: Checks if current AP matches WPS SSID.
